one_line: Name the family-specific detail (the four pets are in the story) and show it on a held-still top-down page flip.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static wide shot: mother on a grey sofa, a baby beside her, a dog crossing the lens, a book in her hand. Voiceover (transcript) and subtitle: "זאת המתנה הכי מרגשת שהענקתי" (name omitted). 0:04 she lifts a box.
q1_hook.why: Voice and subtitle open together (H6) and a person is heard from frame one (H4). "The most moving gift" poses a small question the Reel answers at about 0:09 (H5), later than the 3 to 5 s target for stating the value (H2). The dogs crossing the lens give early movement (H1).

beats.what: Sofa, wide: mother, baby, dogs; she lifts a box printed TinyBook at 0:04, then reads with the baby
beats.why: Gift claim plus home chaos; the book is not described until 0:10

beats.what: Beanbag, high angle: mother and baby read; the book is the baby's story, four dogs added
beats.why: States the personal detail that makes it a keepsake

beats.what: Sofa again: dogs crowd her lap as she reads; subtitle about the reaction, then the hard cover
beats.why: Dogs and baby near the book; the promised recognition is told, not shown

beats.what: Baby alone on the beanbag turns the pages of the open book
beats.why: Shows the book surviving small hands

beats.what: Top-down hands on wood: cover, spreads of the baby and dogs; customer service claim
beats.why: The only clear look at the pages and illustrations

beats.what: Back cover dedication, then a matching colouring book flipped
beats.why: Adds an extra product with new visuals

beats.what: Baby with a pacifier, book on the lap
beats.why: A cute still moment before the ask

beats.what: Mother and baby read; subtitle "תלחצו עכשיו על הלינק למטה"
beats.why: One clear ask on the last frames

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: "👉 רוצים גם מזכרת מטורפת כזו?", a rhetorical question that leads into the link ask. No comment question, nothing to send to a person.
q2_flow.why: Scene changes every 4 to 10 s keep a steady pace (R3). The middle is a spoken list of claims over home scenes (R3). The reaction promised at 0:20 is not shown, so the emotional peak is missing (K1). It ends right after the ask, with no dead tail (R1).

q3_cta.what: Subtitle and voice 0:42-0:47 (transcript): "תלחצו עכשיו על הלינק למטה ותעצבו ספר משלכם". Caption: "לחצו עכשיו על הלינק בביו ותעצבו ספר אישי לילדים שלכם!". No comment word, no price.
q3_cta.why: One action, said, shown and repeated in the caption, after the book has been shown (C1, C6). The subtitle sits at the edge of the bottom 35% (C6). Video says "below", caption "in bio"; the brand is never said or subtitled, so the link's destination is unclear (C7).

q4_shown.what: A shipping box with the brand label 0:04; mother and baby reading 0:08-0:25; the baby alone turning pages 0:26; top-down covers and pages with the baby and dogs, the child's name in the cover title, 0:29-0:35; back cover and colouring book 0:36-0:41. No price.
q4_shown.why: The book is handled and read throughout (S1, K5) and the parent vouches in first person (S6). The dogs and the child's name on the cover are checkable personalising (S8), but no real photo sits beside an illustration (S2). A baby's face with the name on screen is what LumeBook Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: 8 shots in 48 s, about 6 s each; hard cuts, one stacked two-image frame at 0:37. Sofa and beanbag scenes alternate before the table close-ups. Voiceover to the end, subtitles change every 1 to 2 s. Ends on the ask, no end card.
q5_edit.why: A cut every few seconds with a change of angle and place keeps the middle moving (E2, R3). Voice plus synced subtitles work with sound off (E4). Product facts play over repeated sofa and beanbag footage (R3). The Reel ends on the ask (E8).

q6_topic.what: A first-birthday gift: a personalised hardcover with the baby and the family's four dogs, plus a matching colouring book. Serves parents looking for a keepsake no ordinary shop sells.
q6_topic.why: A named occasion and a gift buyer fit a buying moment (K7). The pets are a family detail other parents can picture and send on (R5). Hype wording ("שווה את הכל", "פלוס מטורף") and no hardship moment keep it a showcase, not a story (K6, K2).

q7_filmed.what: Propped static phone: eye-level wide on a sofa in daylight, high-angle medium on a lilac beanbag, a medium shot of the baby alone. Handheld top-down on a wooden table for pages and colouring book. Mother in a top or pyjamas.
q7_filmed.why: Home, daylight and a propped phone look native (H8, F7). Vertical and full frame (F1). The sofa shots make the book small and unreadable, while the top-down hands on wood fill the frame and put the viewer in the reader's seat (F4, F5, S4).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles, two lines, centred about two thirds down, matching the voice every 1 to 2 s: "זאת המתנה הכי" (0:00), "ספר ילדים אישי שנכתב ואויר במיוחד" (0:10), "הספר מגיע בכריכה קשה ועם דפים עבים" (0:24), "בנוסף," (0:36), "תלחצו עכשיו על הלינק למטה" (0:45). No headline card; the brand is only on the box and back cover.
q8_text.caption: "המתנה הכי מטורפת ליום הולדת שנה" plus the child's name. About 70 words, emojis, a tag thanking the vendor, a link-in-bio ask, no hashtags, no disclosure words.
q8_text.why: Subtitling the whole voiceover lets a muted viewer follow (T1), but it is nearly a full transcript, not key words (T2), and sits at the edge of the bottom 35% (T4). The caption's first line names the product and occasion for search (T7). No hashtags, no disclosure (T7, T8).

weak_points: Voiceover reads like an ad script and says an AI model made the book ("ה-ai הכי מתקדם", 0:12). The promised reaction is not shown. The child's name and face together. No disclosure words. Brand never said. "Below" versus "bio".
lumebook_takeaway: Film top-down hands paging one book on a table, holding the page with the family detail (a pet) still for 2 s, then one-line CTA.
not_verified: Whether the book in her hand at 0:00 is the personalised one (a white cover or pages, then a dog hides it). src/coded says the product is first seen at 4.0 s (the box), but a book is in her hand from 0:01. Whether the 0:37 stacked frame is a deliberate transition. Music and natural sound are not evident. Whether the post was paid.
